$comment: A group whose path ends with .[] and that has no iteration key. The behaviour comes from a pending change to the ERC text (ethereum/ERCs pull request 2165: require iteration for two or more array fields, default to bundled). That change edits the v2 schema line in place, so this descriptor points at a v2 schema and not at the 3.0.0-next draft.
